description:
Uses the OMOTON MK212 accent bar as a Windows disk activity indicator.

MK212 DriveGlow is a tiny Windows tray application that turns the side light of the OMOTON MK212 keyboard into a classic disk activity indicator. It offers configurable colors, classic flashing or an activity-level display, optional automatic startup, and SignalRGB coexistence guidance. No additional driver, service, or administrator rights are required.
- Added a dedicated settings dialog for color, light-bar mode, tray display, and automatic startup.
- Added an About tab with a high-resolution app logo, description, version information, and repository link.
- Improved installer metadata and support for per-user Inno Setup installations.
- Updated the application, installer, and documentation to version 1.4.0.
